  | zero => norm_num [topOneFullError,leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [topOne_full_tail]; exact topOne_positive n

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_full_decrease
source:
theorem topOne_full_decrease (j : ℕ) : topOneFullError (j+1)<topOneFullError j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [topOneFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  | succ n =>
    rw [topOne_full_tail,topOne_full_tail]
    change quadraticMap (topOneError n)<topOneError n
    linarith [quadraticMap_half (topOne_positive n).le,topOne_positive n]

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_width_limit
source:
theorem topOne_width_limit : Tendsto (fun j=>1+topOneFullError j) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp
  simpa only [topOne_full_tail,add_zero] using topOne_tendsto.const_add 1

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_actual_update
source:
theorem topOne_actual_update (j : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated oneFunction (-topOneFullError j) 1
      (-topOneFullError (j+1)) (-topOneFullError (j+1)) 1 ∧
    -topOneFullError (j+1)∈Ioo (-topOneFullError j) 1 ∧
    oneFunction (-topOneFullError (j+1))≠0 ∧
    0<1-topOneFullError (j+1)/topOneFullError j := by
  have he:=topOne_full_positive j
  have hn:=topOne_full_positive (j+1)
  have hd:=topOne_full_decrease j
  refine ⟨left_updated (p:=1) he hn (by simpa using oneFunction_left he.le)
    (by simpa using oneFunction_left hn.le),⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [oneFunction_left hn.le]; linarith
  · linarith [(div_lt_one he).mpr hd]

name: ModAB.Examples.topOne_top_entry
source:
theorem topOne_top_entry :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated oneFunction (-3) 1 (-1) (-1) 1 ∧
    topLeftSeed (-3) (2) = ⟨1,2,true⟩ := by
  constructor
  · norm_num [ModAB.Convergence.Updated,oneFunction_formula]
  · exact topLeftSeed_eq _ _

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterPair
source:
def topCounterPair : ℕ→ℝ×ℝ
  | 0=>(2664111/8512544,24001/36692)
  | n+1=>let s:=topCounterPair n; let r:=phi s.1 s.2; (s.1*r,r)

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterError
source: def topCounterError (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (topCounterPair n).1

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterRatio
source: def topCounterRatio (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (topCounterPair n).2

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_recurrence
source:
theorem topCounter_recurrence (n : ℕ) :
    topCounterRatio (n+1)=phi (topCounterError n) (topCounterRatio n) ∧
    topCounterError (n+1)=topCounterError n*topCounterRatio (n+1) := by
  constructor <;> rfl

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_invariant
source:
theorem topCounter_invariant (n : ℕ) :
    0<topCounterError n ∧ topCounterError n≤2/5 ∧ topCounterRatio n∈Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10) := by
  induction n with
  | zero=>norm_num [topCounterError,topCounterRatio,topCounterPair]
  | succ n ih=>
    have hp:=phi_region ⟨ih.1.le,ih.2.1⟩ ih.2.2
    have hr : topCounterRatio (n+1)∈Icc (1/2:ℝ) (7/10):=by
      rw [(topCounter_recurrence n).1]
      constructor <;> linarith [hp.1,hp.2]
    have hpos : 0<topCounterRatio (n+1):=by linarith [hr.1]
    rw [(topCounter_recurrence n).2]
    exact ⟨mul_pos ih.1 hpos,by nlinarith [hr.2],hr⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_error_shrinks
source:
theorem topCounter_error_shrinks (n : ℕ) :
    topCounterError (n+1)≤(7/10)*topCounterError n := by
  rw [(topCounter_recurrence n).2]
  nlinarith [(topCounter_invariant n).1,(topCounter_invariant (n+1)).2.2.2]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterError_tendsto
source:
theorem topCounterError_tendsto : Tendsto topCounterError atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  geometric_tendsto (fun n=>(topCounter_invariant n).1.le) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) topCounter_error_shrinks

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_width_limit
source:
theorem topCounter_width_limit : Tendsto (fun n=>1+topCounterError n) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  simpa using topCounterError_tendsto.const_add 1

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterPrevious
source:
def topCounterPrevious : ℕ→ℝ
  | 0=>111/232
  | n+1=>topCounterError n

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_ratio_identity
source:
theorem topCounter_ratio_identity (n : ℕ) :
    topCounterError n=topCounterRatio n*topCounterPrevious n := by
  cases n with
  | zero=>norm_num [topCounterError,topCounterRatio,topCounterPair,topCounterPrevious]
  | succ n=>simpa only [topCounterPrevious,mul_comm] using (topCounter_recurrence n).2

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterPrevious_positive
source:
theorem topCounterPrevious_positive (n : ℕ) : 0<topCounterPrevious n := by
  cases n with
  | zero=>norm_num [topCounterPrevious]
  | succ n=>exact (topCounter_invariant n).1

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterState
source:
def topCounterState (n : ℕ) : LeftState :=
  ⟨topCounterError n,(1+topCounterError n)*(topCounterPrevious n+topCounterError n),true⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_state_step
source:
theorem topCounter_state_step (n : ℕ) : leftStep 2 (topCounterState n)=topCounterState (n+1) := by
  have hi:=topCounter_invariant n
  have hp:=topCounterPrevious_positive n
  have hr : 0<topCounterRatio n:=by linarith [hi.2.2.1]
  have hv : 0<(1+topCounterError n)*(topCounterPrevious n+topCounterError n):=
    mul_pos (by linarith [hi.1]) (by linarith [hi.1,hp])
  have ht:=counter_trial_identity hi.1 hp hr (topCounter_ratio_identity n)
  have ht' : leftTrial 2 (topCounterError n)
      ((1+topCounterError n)*(topCounterPrevious n+topCounterError n))=topCounterError (n+1) := by
    rw [ht,(topCounter_recurrence n).2,(topCounter_recurrence n).1]
  have hc:=counter_correction_identity hi.1 hv ht'.symm
  simp only [leftStep,topCounterState,ite_true]
  rw [ht',hc]
  rfl

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_first_steps
source:
theorem topCounter_first_steps :
    (leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ 1).e=3/4 ∧
    (leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ 2).e=111/232 ∧
    leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ 3=topCounterState 0 := by
  norm_num [leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,topCounterState,topCounterError,topCounterRatio,topCounterPair,topCounterPrevious]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_orbit
source:
theorem topCounter_orbit (n : ℕ) : leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ (n+3)=topCounterState n := by
  induction n with
  | zero=>exact topCounter_first_steps.2.2
  | succ n ih=>
    change leftStep 2 (leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ (n+3))=topCounterState (n+1)
    rw [ih]
    exact topCounter_state_step n

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_actual_update
source:
theorem topCounter_actual_update (n : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated counterFunction (-topCounterError n) 1
      (-topCounterError (n+1)) (-topCounterError (n+1)) 1 := by
  exact left_updated (p:=2) (topCounter_invariant n).1 (topCounter_invariant (n+1)).1
    (counterFunction_left (topCounter_invariant n).1.le)
    (counterFunction_left (topCounter_invariant (n+1)).1.le)

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_residual_ratio
source:
theorem topCounter_residual_ratio (n : ℕ) :
    |counterFunction (-topCounterError n)| /
      min |counterFunction (-topCounterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1|≤49/100 := by
  have hp:=topCounterPrevious_positive n
  have hi:=topCounter_invariant n
  have hprev : topCounterPrevious n≤1:=by
    cases n with
    | zero=>norm_num [topCounterPrevious]
    | succ k=>exact le_trans (topCounter_invariant k).2.1 (by norm_num)
  rw [counterFunction_left hi.1.le,counterFunction_left hp.le]
  have hf : counterFunction 1=7:=by norm_num [counterFunction,gluedQuadratic]
  rw [hf,abs_neg,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  norm_num only [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<7)]
  have hmin : min ((topCounterPrevious n)^2) (7:ℝ)=(topCounterPrevious n)^2:=by
    apply min_eq_left
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hprev)]
  rw [hmin,topCounter_ratio_identity n]
  have hid : (topCounterRatio n*topCounterPrevious n)^2/(topCounterPrevious n)^2=(topCounterRatio n)^2:=by
    field_simp
  rw [hid]
  nlinarith [hi.2.2.1,hi.2.2.2]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_hybrid_entry
source:
theorem topCounter_hybrid_entry :
    counterFunction (-3)=-9 ∧ counterFunction 1=7 ∧ counterFunction (-1)=-1 ∧
    ModAB.originalL (-9) 7 (-1)<ModAB.originalR ((1-(1:ℝ)/16)^2) (-9) 7 (-1) := by
  norm_num [counterFunction,gluedQuadratic,ModAB.originalL,ModAB.originalR]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_admissible_step
source:
theorem topCounter_admissible_step (n : ℕ) :
    -topCounterError (n+1)∈Ioo (-topCounterError n) 1 ∧
    counterFunction (-topCounterError (n+1))≠0 ∧
    0<1-(topCounterError (n+1))^2/(topCounterError n)^2 := by
  have he:=(topCounter_invariant n).1
  have hn:=(topCounter_invariant (n+1)).1
  have hs:=topCounter_error_shrinks n
  have hlt : topCounterError (n+1)<topCounterError n:=by linarith
  constructor
  · constructor <;> linarith
  · constructor
    · intro hz
      have heq:=(counterFunction_zero_iff _).mp hz
      linarith
    · have hsq : (topCounterError (n+1))^2<(topCounterError n)^2:=by nlinarith
      have hratio : (topCounterError (n+1))^2/(topCounterError n)^2<1:=
        (div_lt_one (sq_pos_of_pos he)).mpr hsq
      linarith

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_residual_exception
source:
theorem topCounter_residual_exception (n : ℕ) :
    |counterFunction (-topCounterError n)| < (1/2)*
      min |counterFunction (-topCounterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1| := by
  have hp:=topCounterPrevious_positive n
  have hm : 0<min |counterFunction (-topCounterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1| := by
    apply lt_min
    · rw [counterFunction_left hp.le,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact sq_pos_of_pos hp
    · norm_num [counterFunction,gluedQuadratic]
  have hb:=topCounter_residual_ratio n
  have hm' := (div_le_iff₀ hm).mp hb
  nlinarith only [hm,hm']

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_width_test_fails
source:
theorem topCounter_width_test_fails (n : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)<1+topCounterError n := by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^3≤2^(n+3):=pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hpow : 0<(2:ℝ)^(n+3):=by positivity
  have ht : ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)≤1:=by
    unfold ModAB.Convergence.threshold
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hpow).mpr
    norm_num at hp ⊢
    exact hp
  linarith [(topCounter_invariant n).1]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterFullError
source: def topCounterFullError (j : ℕ) : ℝ := (leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ j).e

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_full_tail
source:
theorem topCounter_full_tail (n : ℕ) : topCounterFullError (n+3)=topCounterError n := by
  simp only [topCounterFullError,topCounter_orbit,topCounterState]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterFullError_positive
source:
theorem topCounterFullError_positive (j : ℕ) : 0<topCounterFullError j := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit]
  · norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  · norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  · exact topCounter_full_tail n ▸ (topCounter_invariant n).1

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_full_width_limit
source:
theorem topCounter_full_width_limit : Tendsto (fun j=>1+topCounterFullError j) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 3).mp
  simpa only [topCounter_full_tail] using topCounter_width_limit

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounterFullError_tendsto
source:
theorem topCounterFullError_tendsto : Tendsto topCounterFullError atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 3).mp
  simpa only [topCounter_full_tail] using topCounterError_tendsto

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_full_strict_decrease
source:
theorem topCounter_full_strict_decrease (j : ℕ) : topCounterFullError (j+1)<topCounterFullError j := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  · norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  · norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  · rw [show n+3+1=(n+1)+3 by omega,topCounter_full_tail,topCounter_full_tail]
    linarith [topCounter_error_shrinks n,(topCounter_invariant n).1]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_full_ordinate_positive
source:
theorem topCounter_full_ordinate_positive (j : ℕ) : 0<(leftOrbit 2 ⟨1,7,true⟩ j).v := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · norm_num [leftOrbit]
  · norm_num [leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  · norm_num [leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  · rw [topCounter_orbit]
    change 0<(1+topCounterError n)*(topCounterPrevious n+topCounterError n)
    exact mul_pos (by linarith [(topCounter_invariant n).1])
      (by linarith [(topCounter_invariant n).1,topCounterPrevious_positive n])

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_full_actual_update
source:
theorem topCounter_full_actual_update (j : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated counterFunction (-topCounterFullError j) 1
      (-topCounterFullError (j+1)) (-topCounterFullError (j+1)) 1 ∧
    -topCounterFullError (j+1)∈Ioo (-topCounterFullError j) 1 ∧
    counterFunction (-topCounterFullError (j+1))≠0 := by
  have he:=topCounterFullError_positive j
  have hn:=topCounterFullError_positive (j+1)
  have hd:=topCounter_full_strict_decrease j
  refine ⟨left_updated (p:=2) he hn (counterFunction_left he.le)
    (counterFunction_left hn.le),⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩,?_⟩
  intro hz
  have heq:=(counterFunction_zero_iff _).mp hz
  linarith

name: ModAB.Examples.topUncappedContinues
source:
def topUncappedContinues (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1+topCounterFullError j≤ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 j ∨
  |counterFunction (-topCounterFullError j)|<(1/2)*
    min |counterFunction (-topCounterFullError (j-1))| |counterFunction 1|

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_uncapped_continues
source:
theorem topCounter_uncapped_continues (j : ℕ) (hj : 1≤j) : topUncappedContinues j := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · omega
  · left; norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · left; norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · right
    have hp : topCounterFullError (n+3-1)=topCounterPrevious n := by
      cases n with
      | zero=>norm_num [topCounterFullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,topCounterPrevious]
      | succ n=>
        rw [show n+1+3-1=n+3 by omega,topCounter_full_tail]
        rfl
    rw [topCounter_full_tail,hp]
    exact topCounter_residual_exception n

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_no_width_termination
source:
theorem topCounter_no_width_termination {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ≤1) (j : ℕ) :
    τ<1+topCounterFullError j := by linarith [topCounterFullError_positive j]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_mixed_tolerance_fails
source:
theorem topCounter_mixed_tolerance_fails {ea er : ℝ} (ha : ea<1) :
    ∀ᶠj in atTop,ea+er*|(-topCounterFullError j)|<1+topCounterFullError j := by
  have ht := ((topCounterFullError_tendsto.neg).abs.const_mul er).const_add ea
  have ht' : Tendsto (fun j=>ea+er*|(-topCounterFullError j)|) atTop (𝓝 ea):=by
    simpa using ht
  have hevent := (tendsto_order.mp ht').2 1 ha
  filter_upwards [hevent] with j hj
  linarith [topCounterFullError_positive j]

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_global_bound_violation
source:
theorem topCounter_global_bound_violation :
    (4:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^(14/7)<1+topCounterFullError 13 := by
  have h:=topCounterFullError_positive 13
  norm_num
  linarith

name: ModAB.Examples.topUncapped_counterexample
source:
theorem topUncapped_counterexample :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 counterFunction ∧ (∀x,counterFunction x=0↔x=0) ∧
    (∀j,1≤j→topUncappedContinues j) ∧
    Tendsto (fun j=>1+topCounterFullError j) atTop (𝓝 1) ∧
    (∀n,|counterFunction (-topCounterError n)| /
      min |counterFunction (-topCounterPrevious n)| |counterFunction 1|≤49/100) :=
  ⟨counterFunction_C1,counterFunction_zero_iff,topCounter_uncapped_continues,
    topCounter_full_width_limit,topCounter_residual_ratio⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_top_entry
source:
theorem topCounter_top_entry :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated counterFunction (-3) 1 (-1) (-1) 1 ∧
    topLeftSeed (-9) (7) = ⟨1,7,true⟩ := by
  constructor
  · norm_num [ModAB.Convergence.Updated,counterFunction_formula]
  · exact topLeftSeed_eq _ _

name: ModAB.Examples.topCounter_full_correction
source:
theorem topCounter_full_correction (j : ℕ) :
    0 < 1-(topCounterFullError (j+1))^2/(topCounterFullError j)^2 := by
  have he := topCounterFullError_positive j
  have hn := topCounterFullError_positive (j+1)
  have hd := topCounter_full_strict_decrease j
  have hs : (topCounterFullError (j+1))^2 < (topCounterFullError j)^2 := by nlinarith
  linarith [(div_lt_one (sq_pos_of_pos he)).mpr hs]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42Function
source: def eta42Function (x : ℝ) : ℝ := x+gluedQuadratic 0 (1/10) x

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_formula
source:
theorem eta42_formula (x : ℝ) :
    eta42Function x = if x≤0 then x else x+x^2/10 := by
  unfold eta42Function gluedQuadratic
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_C1
source:
theorem eta42_C1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 eta42Function :=
  contDiff_id.add (gluedQuadratic_C1 0 (1/10))

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_left
source:
theorem eta42_left {e : ℝ} (he : 0≤e) : eta42Function (-e) = -e := by
  rw [eta42_formula,if_pos (by linarith)]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_right
source: theorem eta42_right : eta42Function 1 = 11/10 := by norm_num [eta42_formula]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_zero_iff
source:
theorem eta42_zero_iff (x : ℝ) : eta42Function x=0 ↔ x=0 := by
  rw [eta42_formula]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · constructor
    · intro hz; nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
    · intro hz; simp [hz]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_simple_root
source:
theorem eta42_simple_root : HasDerivAt eta42Function 1 0 := by
  convert (hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).add
    (gluedQuadratic_hasDerivAt_zero 0 (1/10)) using 1 <;> try norm_num
  funext x
  simp [eta42Function]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_strictMono
source:
theorem eta42_strictMono : StrictMono eta42Function := by
  intro a b hab
  rw [eta42_formula,eta42_formula]
  split_ifs with ha hb
  · exact hab
  · nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
  · linarith
  · nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) (show 0<b+a by linarith)]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_hybrid_entry
source:
theorem eta42_hybrid_entry :
    eta42Function (-3)=-3 ∧ eta42Function 1=11/10 ∧ eta42Function (-1)=-1 ∧
    ModAB.originalL (-3) (11/10) (-1) <
      ModAB.originalR ((1-(19/20)/(41/10))^2) (-3) (11/10) (-1) := by
  norm_num [eta42_formula,ModAB.originalL,ModAB.originalR]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42Error
source:
def eta42Error : ℕ→ℝ
  | 0 => 1/21
  | n+1 => quadraticMap (eta42Error n)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42State
source: def eta42State (n : ℕ) : LeftState := ⟨eta42Error n,1+eta42Error n,true⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_positive
source:
theorem eta42_positive (n : ℕ) : 0<eta42Error n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42Error]
  | succ n ih => exact quadraticMap_positive ih

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_step
source:
theorem eta42_step (n : ℕ) : leftStep 1 (eta42State n) = eta42State (n+1) :=
  quadratic_step (eta42_positive n)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_first_steps
source:
theorem eta42_first_steps :
    leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ 1 = eta42State 0 ∧
    eta42Error 1=1/483 ∧ eta42Error 2=1/234255 := by
  norm_num [leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,eta42State,eta42Error,quadraticMap]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_orbit
source:
theorem eta42_orbit (n : ℕ) : leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ (n+1)=eta42State n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact eta42_first_steps.1
  | succ n ih =>
    change leftStep 1 (leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ (n+1)) = eta42State (n+1)
    rw [ih,eta42_step]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_shrinks
source:
theorem eta42_shrinks (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1) ≤ (1/2)*eta42Error n :=
  quadraticMap_half (eta42_positive n).le

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_strict_decrease
source:
theorem eta42_strict_decrease (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1)<eta42Error n := by
  linarith [eta42_shrinks n,eta42_positive n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_antitone
source:
theorem eta42_antitone : Antitone eta42Error :=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n=>(eta42_strict_decrease n).le)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_bound
source:
theorem eta42_bound (n : ℕ) : eta42Error n ≤ 1/21 :=
  eta42_antitone (Nat.zero_le n)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_next_bound
source:
theorem eta42_next_bound (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1) ≤ 1/483 := by
  rw [← eta42_first_steps.2.1]
  exact eta42_antitone (by omega)

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_tendsto
source:
theorem eta42_tendsto : Tendsto eta42Error atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  geometric_tendsto (fun n=>(eta42_positive n).le) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) eta42_shrinks

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_reciprocal
source:
theorem eta42_reciprocal (n : ℕ) : 1+1/eta42Error n = (22:ℝ)^(2^n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42Error]
  | succ n ih =>
    have he := ne_of_gt (eta42_positive n)
    calc
      1+1/eta42Error (n+1) = (1+1/eta42Error n)^2 := by
        simp only [eta42Error,quadraticMap]
        field_simp
        <;> ring
      _ = ((22:ℝ)^(2^n))^2 := by rw [ih]
      _ = (22:ℝ)^(2^(n+1)) := by rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_closed_form
source:
theorem eta42_closed_form (n : ℕ) : eta42Error n = 1/((22:ℝ)^(2^n)-1) := by
  rw [← eta42_reciprocal]
  simp

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_quadratic_order
source:
theorem eta42_quadratic_order :
    Tendsto (fun n=>eta42Error (n+1)/(eta42Error n)^2) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hq (n : ℕ) : eta42Error (n+1)/(eta42Error n)^2=1/(1+2*eta42Error n) := by
    have he := ne_of_gt (eta42_positive n)
    simp only [eta42Error,quadraticMap]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [hq]
  have ht := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ=>(1:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)).div
    ((eta42_tendsto.const_mul 2).const_add 1) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)+2*0≠0)
  change Tendsto (fun n=>(1:ℝ)/(1+2*eta42Error n)) atTop (𝓝 (1/(1+2*(0:ℝ)))) at ht
  simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero,div_one,one_div] using ht

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42FullError
source: def eta42FullError (j : ℕ) : ℝ := (leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ j).e

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_tail
source:
theorem eta42_full_tail (n : ℕ) : eta42FullError (n+1)=eta42Error n := by
  simp only [eta42FullError,eta42_orbit,eta42State]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_positive
source:
theorem eta42_full_positive (j : ℕ) : 0<eta42FullError j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_full_tail]; exact eta42_positive n

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_decrease
source:
theorem eta42_full_decrease (j : ℕ) : eta42FullError (j+1)<eta42FullError j := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_full_tail,eta42_full_tail]; exact eta42_strict_decrease n

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_bound
source:
theorem eta42_full_bound (j : ℕ) : eta42FullError j ≤ 1 := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_full_tail]; linarith [eta42_bound n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_tendsto
source:
theorem eta42_full_tendsto : Tendsto eta42FullError atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp
  simpa only [eta42_full_tail] using eta42_tendsto

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_width_limit
source:
theorem eta42_width_limit : Tendsto (fun j=>1+eta42FullError j) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  simpa using eta42_full_tendsto.const_add 1

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_full_ordinate_positive
source:
theorem eta42_full_ordinate_positive (j : ℕ) :
    0 < (leftOrbit 1 ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ j).v := by
  cases j with
  | zero => norm_num [leftOrbit]
  | succ n => rw [eta42_orbit]; change 0<1+eta42Error n; linarith [eta42_positive n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_positive_correction
source:
theorem eta42_positive_correction (j : ℕ) :
    0 < 1-eta42FullError (j+1)/eta42FullError j ∧
    ModAB.Convergence.abFactor (-eta42FullError (j+1)) (-eta42FullError j) =
      1-eta42FullError (j+1)/eta42FullError j := by
  have h := (div_lt_one (eta42_full_positive j)).mpr (eta42_full_decrease j)
  have hp : 0<1-eta42FullError (j+1)/eta42FullError j := by linarith
  exact ⟨hp,by simp [ModAB.Convergence.abFactor,hp]⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_actual_update
source:
theorem eta42_actual_update (j : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated eta42Function (-eta42FullError j) 1
      (-eta42FullError (j+1)) (-eta42FullError (j+1)) 1 ∧
    -eta42FullError (j+1)∈Ioo (-eta42FullError j) 1 ∧
    eta42Function (-eta42FullError (j+1))≠0 := by
  have he:=eta42_full_positive j
  have hn:=eta42_full_positive (j+1)
  have hd:=eta42_full_decrease j
  refine ⟨left_updated (p:=1) he hn (by simpa using eta42_left he.le)
    (by simpa using eta42_left hn.le),⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩,?_⟩
  rw [eta42_left hn.le]; linarith

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_residual_ratio
source:
theorem eta42_residual_ratio (n : ℕ) :
    eta42FullError (n+3)/eta42FullError (n+2) ≤ 1/485 := by
  rw [show n+3=(n+2)+1 by omega,show n+2=(n+1)+1 by omega,
    eta42_full_tail,eta42_full_tail]
  change quadraticMap (eta42Error (n+1))/eta42Error (n+1) ≤ 1/485
  have he:=eta42_positive (n+1)
  have hd : 0<1+2*eta42Error (n+1) := by positivity
  have hq : quadraticMap (eta42Error (n+1))/eta42Error (n+1) =
      eta42Error (n+1)/(1+2*eta42Error (n+1)) := by
    unfold quadraticMap; field_simp
  rw [hq]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
  linarith [eta42_next_bound n]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_residual_exception
source:
theorem eta42_residual_exception (n : ℕ) :
    |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (n+3))| < (1/42)*
      min |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (n+2))| |eta42Function 1| := by
  have he:=eta42_full_positive (n+2)
  rw [eta42_left (eta42_full_positive (n+3)).le,eta42_left he.le,eta42_right,
    abs_neg,abs_neg,abs_of_pos (eta42_full_positive (n+3)),abs_of_pos he]
  norm_num only [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<11/10)]
  rw [min_eq_left (show eta42FullError (n+2)≤11/10 by linarith [eta42_full_bound (n+2)])]
  have h:=(div_le_iff₀ he).mp (eta42_residual_ratio n)
  nlinarith only [h,he]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_width_test_fails
source:
theorem eta42_width_test_fails (n : ℕ) :
    ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)<1+eta42FullError (n+3) := by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^3≤2^(n+3):=pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have ht : ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 (n+3)≤1:=by
    unfold ModAB.Convergence.threshold
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<(2:ℝ)^(n+3))).mpr
    norm_num at hp ⊢
    exact hp
  linarith [eta42_full_positive (n+3)]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42UncappedContinues
source:
def eta42UncappedContinues (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1+eta42FullError j≤ModAB.Convergence.threshold 2 2 j ∨
  |eta42Function (-eta42FullError j)| < (1/42)*
    min |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (j-1))| |eta42Function 1|

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_uncapped_continues
source:
theorem eta42_uncapped_continues (j : ℕ) (hj : 1≤j) : eta42UncappedContinues j := by
  rcases j with _|_|_|n
  · omega
  · left; norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · left; norm_num [eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]
  · right
    rw [show n+3-1=n+2 by omega]
    exact eta42_residual_exception n

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_no_width_termination
source:
theorem eta42_no_width_termination {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ≤1) (j : ℕ) :
    τ<1+eta42FullError j := by linarith [eta42_full_positive j]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_mixed_tolerance_fails
source:
theorem eta42_mixed_tolerance_fails {ea er : ℝ} (ha : ea<1) :
    ∀ᶠj in atTop,ea+er*|(-eta42FullError j)|<1+eta42FullError j := by
  have ht := ((eta42_full_tendsto.neg).abs.const_mul er).const_add ea
  have ht' : Tendsto (fun j=>ea+er*|(-eta42FullError j)|) atTop (𝓝 ea):=by simpa using ht
  have hevent := (tendsto_order.mp ht').2 1 ha
  filter_upwards [hevent] with j hj
  linarith [eta42_full_positive j]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42NextMode
source:
def eta42NextMode (t c : ℕ) : ModAB.Convergence.Mode :=
  ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode 2 2 (1/42)
    |eta42Function (-eta42FullError (t+1))|
    (min |eta42Function (-eta42FullError t)| |eta42Function 1|)
    (1+eta42FullError (t+1)) 3 t c

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_capped_exception
source:
theorem eta42_capped_exception (n c : ℕ) (hc : c<3) :
    eta42NextMode (n+2) c = .ab 2 (n+3) (c+1) := by
  have hw := not_le.mpr (eta42_width_test_fails n)
  have hr := eta42_residual_exception n
  simp only [eta42NextMode,ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode]
  rw [if_neg hw,if_pos ⟨hr,hc⟩]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_cap_forces_fallback
source:
theorem eta42_cap_forces_fallback (n : ℕ) : eta42NextMode (n+2) 3 = .bisection := by
  have hw := not_le.mpr (eta42_width_test_fails n)
  simp only [eta42NextMode,ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode]
  rw [if_neg hw]
  norm_num

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_capped_schedule
source:
theorem eta42_capped_schedule :
    eta42NextMode 0 0 = .ab 2 1 0 ∧ eta42NextMode 1 0 = .ab 2 2 0 ∧
    eta42NextMode 2 0 = .ab 2 3 1 ∧ eta42NextMode 3 1 = .ab 2 4 2 ∧
    eta42NextMode 4 2 = .ab 2 5 3 ∧ eta42NextMode 5 3 = .bisection := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,eta42_capped_exception 0 0 (by norm_num),
    eta42_capped_exception 1 1 (by norm_num),eta42_capped_exception 2 2 (by norm_num),
    eta42_cap_forces_fallback 3⟩
  all_goals norm_num [eta42NextMode,ModAB.Convergence.adaptiveMode,
    eta42FullError,leftOrbit,leftStep,leftTrial,ModAB.Convergence.threshold]

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_uncapped_counterexample
source:
theorem eta42_uncapped_counterexample :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 eta42Function ∧ StrictMono eta42Function ∧
    (∀x,eta42Function x=0↔x=0) ∧ HasDerivAt eta42Function 1 0 ∧
    (∀j,1≤j→eta42UncappedContinues j) ∧
    Tendsto eta42FullError atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun j=>1+eta42FullError j) atTop (𝓝 1) :=
  ⟨eta42_C1,eta42_strictMono,eta42_zero_iff,eta42_simple_root,
    eta42_uncapped_continues,eta42_full_tendsto,eta42_width_limit⟩

name: ModAB.Examples.eta42_top_entry
source:
theorem eta42_top_entry :
    ModAB.Convergence.Updated eta42Function (-3) 1 (-1) (-1) 1 ∧
    topLeftSeed (-3) (11/10) = ⟨1,11/10,true⟩ := by
  constructor
  · norm_num [ModAB.Convergence.Updated,eta42_formula]
  · exact topLeftSeed_eq _ _

name: ModAB.Rational.secant
source:
def secant (a b ya yb : ℝ) : ℝ := (a*yb-b*ya)/(yb-ya)

/-- Distance of the secant to its nearer endpoint. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.radius
ModAB.Rational.normalizedDenominator
source:
def normalizedDenominator (w u q qp : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  w*(qp-q)-u*qp*(1-q)

name: ModAB.Rational.normalizedNumerator
source: def normalizedNumerator (w u q qp : ℝ) : ℝ := w*u*q*(qp-1)

name: ModAB.Rational.normalizedOffset
source:
def normalizedOffset (w u q qp : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  normalizedNumerator w u q qp / normalizedDenominator w u q qp

name: ModAB.Rational.denominator
source:
def denominator (a b ya yb xp fp : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  normalizedDenominator (b-a) (xp-a) (ya/yb) (fp/yb)

name: ModAB.Rational.rawPoint
ModAB.Rational.limited
source:
def limited (a b ya yb raw : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let s := secant a b ya yb
  let d := radius a b ya yb
  max (s-(7/10:ℝ)*d) (min raw (s+(7/10:ℝ)*d))

/-- Guarded exact-real completion, not the literal exceptional path of C#.
Curvature may disable the proposal. A zero rational denominator falls back
to the secant here; C# instead uses IEEE infinity/NaN and its right-endpoint
fallback. Every admitted finite rational value is projected. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.candidate
source:
def candidate (a b ya yb xp fp : ℝ) (allowRational : Bool) : ℝ :=
  if allowRational = true ∧ denominator a b ya yb xp fp ≠ 0
  then limited a b ya yb (rawPoint a b ya yb xp fp)
  else secant a b ya yb

name: ModAB.Rational.secant_interior
source:
theorem secant_interior {a b ya yb : ℝ} (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) :
    secant a b ya yb ∈ Ioo a b :=
  ModAB.Convergence.secant_interior hab hy

name: ModAB.Rational.working_ratio_negative
source:
theorem working_ratio_negative {ya yb : ℝ} (hy : ya*yb<0) : ya/yb<0 := by
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hy with h|h
  · exact div_neg_of_pos_of_neg h.1 h.2
  · exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos h.1 h.2

name: ModAB.Rational.working_second_ne_zero
source:
theorem working_second_ne_zero {ya yb : ℝ} (hy : ya*yb<0) : yb≠0 := by
  intro h
  simp [h] at hy

name: ModAB.Rational.secant_normalized
source:
theorem secant_normalized {a b ya yb : ℝ} (hy : ya*yb<0) :
    secant a b ya yb = a-(b-a)*(ya/yb)/(1-ya/yb) := by
  have hv := working_second_ne_zero hy
  have hq := working_ratio_negative hy
  have hc : 1-ya/yb≠0 := by linarith
  have hd : yb-ya≠0 := by
    intro h
    have he : yb=ya := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    rw [he] at hy
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ya]
  unfold secant
  field_simp [hv,hc,hd]
  ring

name: ModAB.Rational.radius_pos
source:
theorem radius_pos {a b ya yb : ℝ} (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) :
    0<radius a b ya yb := by
  have hs := secant_interior hab hy
  unfold radius
  exact lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hs.1) (sub_pos.mpr hs.2)

name: ModAB.Rational.radius_le_left
source:
theorem radius_le_left (a b ya yb : ℝ) :
    radius a b ya yb ≤ secant a b ya yb-a := min_le_left _ _

name: ModAB.Rational.radius_le_right
source:
theorem radius_le_right (a b ya yb : ℝ) :
    radius a b ya yb ≤ b-secant a b ya yb := min_le_right _ _

name: ModAB.Rational.limited_bounds
source:
theorem limited_bounds {a b ya yb raw : ℝ} (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) :
    secant a b ya yb-(7/10:ℝ)*radius a b ya yb ≤ limited a b ya yb raw ∧
    limited a b ya yb raw ≤ secant a b ya yb+(7/10:ℝ)*radius a b ya yb := by
  have hd := radius_pos hab hy
  unfold limited
  dsimp
  exact ⟨le_max_left _ _,max_le (by nlinarith) (min_le_right _ _)⟩

name: ModAB.Rational.limited_margins
source:
theorem limited_margins {a b ya yb raw : ℝ} (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) :
    a+(3/10:ℝ)*radius a b ya yb ≤ limited a b ya yb raw ∧
    limited a b ya yb raw ≤ b-(3/10:ℝ)*radius a b ya yb := by
  have hb := limited_bounds (raw:=raw) hab hy
  have hl := radius_le_left a b ya yb
  have hr := radius_le_right a b ya yb
  constructor <;> nlinarith [hb.1,hb.2]

name: ModAB.Rational.limited_interior
source:
theorem limited_interior {a b ya yb raw : ℝ} (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) :
    limited a b ya yb raw ∈ Ioo a b := by
  have hd := radius_pos hab hy
  have hm := limited_margins (raw:=raw) hab hy
  constructor <;> nlinarith [hm.1,hm.2]

name: ModAB.Rational.limited_eq_self
source:
theorem limited_eq_self {a b ya yb raw : ℝ}
    (hl : secant a b ya yb-(7/10:ℝ)*radius a b ya yb ≤ raw)
    (hr : raw ≤ secant a b ya yb+(7/10:ℝ)*radius a b ya yb) :
    limited a b ya yb raw=raw := by
  unfold limited
  dsimp
  rw [min_eq_left hr,max_eq_right hl]

name: ModAB.Rational.candidate_interior
source:
theorem candidate_interior {a b ya yb xp fp : ℝ} (allowRational : Bool)
    (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) :
    candidate a b ya yb xp fp allowRational ∈ Ioo a b := by
  unfold candidate
  split_ifs
  · exact limited_interior hab hy
  · exact secant_interior hab hy

name: ModAB.Rational.candidate_fallback_denominator
source:
theorem candidate_fallback_denominator {a b ya yb xp fp : ℝ}
    (allowRational : Bool) (h : denominator a b ya yb xp fp=0) :
    candidate a b ya yb xp fp allowRational=secant a b ya yb := by
  simp [candidate,h]

name: ModAB.Rational.candidate_fallback_curvature
source:
theorem candidate_fallback_curvature (a b ya yb xp fp : ℝ) :
    candidate a b ya yb xp fp false=secant a b ya yb := by
  simp [candidate]

/-- A conservative exact-real proposal relation for the source branches.
The projected cases cover finite proposals and the two limiting projections of
infinities; the right endpoint admits the source's NaN/rounding fallback.
This is not a theorem about all IEEE operations in the implementation. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.SourceProposal
source:
def SourceProposal (a b ya yb x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  x=secant a b ya yb ∨ (∃raw,x=limited a b ya yb raw) ∨ x=b

name: ModAB.Rational.sourceProposal_mem_closed
source:
theorem sourceProposal_mem_closed {a b ya yb x : ℝ}
    (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) (h : SourceProposal a b ya yb x) :
    x ∈ Icc a b := by
  rcases h with rfl|⟨raw,rfl⟩|rfl
  · have hs := secant_interior hab hy
    exact ⟨hs.1.le,hs.2.le⟩
  · have hs := limited_interior (raw:=raw) hab hy
    exact ⟨hs.1.le,hs.2.le⟩
  · exact ⟨hab.le,le_rfl⟩

name: ModAB.Rational.sourceProposal_interior_of_ne_right
source:
theorem sourceProposal_interior_of_ne_right {a b ya yb x : ℝ}
    (hab : a<b) (hy : ya*yb<0) (h : SourceProposal a b ya yb x)
    (hne : x≠b) : x ∈ Ioo a b := by
  rcases h with rfl|⟨raw,rfl⟩|rfl
  · exact secant_interior hab hy
  · exact limited_interior hab hy
  · exact False.elim (hne rfl)

name: ModAB.Rational.candidate_is_sourceProposal
source:
theorem candidate_is_sourceProposal (a b ya yb xp fp : ℝ) (allowRational : Bool) :
    SourceProposal a b ya yb (candidate a b ya yb xp fp allowRational) := by
  unfold candidate
  split_ifs
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨_,rfl⟩)
  · exact Or.inl rfl

/-- Source-order closing operation, applied AFTER the secant-relative clamp.
The supplied tolerance is computed from the pre-closing point. The source's
second guard prevents a displacement past the opposite endpoint. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.closeCandidate
source:
def closeCandidate (a b tolerance x : ℝ) (mostRecent : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide) : ℝ :=
  match mostRecent with
  | .left => if x-a<tolerance/2 ∧ a+tolerance/2<b then a+tolerance/2 else x
  | .right => if b-x<tolerance/2 ∧ a<b-tolerance/2 then b-tolerance/2 else x

name: ModAB.Rational.closeCandidate_interior
source:
theorem closeCandidate_interior {a b tolerance x : ℝ}
    (mostRecent : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide)
    (ht : 0<tolerance) (hx : x∈Ioo a b) :
    closeCandidate a b tolerance x mostRecent ∈ Ioo a b := by
  cases mostRecent <;> dsimp only [closeCandidate] <;> split_ifs with h
  · exact ⟨by linarith,h.2⟩
  · exact hx
  · exact ⟨h.2,by linarith⟩
  · exact hx

name: ModAB.Rational.closeCandidate_mem_closed
source:
theorem closeCandidate_mem_closed {a b tolerance x : ℝ}
    (mostRecent : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide)
    (ht : 0<tolerance) (hx : x∈Icc a b) :
    closeCandidate a b tolerance x mostRecent ∈ Icc a b := by
  cases mostRecent <;> dsimp only [closeCandidate] <;> split_ifs with h
  · exact ⟨by linarith,h.2.le⟩
  · exact hx
  · exact ⟨h.2.le,by linarith⟩
  · exact hx

name: ModAB.Rational.closeCandidate_left_separation
source:
theorem closeCandidate_left_separation {a b tolerance x : ℝ}
    (ht : 0<tolerance) (hw : tolerance<b-a) :
    a+tolerance/2 ≤ closeCandidate a b tolerance x .left := by
  have hg : a+tolerance/2<b := by linarith
  simp only [closeCandidate,hg,and_true]
  split_ifs with h <;> linarith

name: ModAB.Rational.closeCandidate_right_separation
source:
theorem closeCandidate_right_separation {a b tolerance x : ℝ}
    (ht : 0<tolerance) (hw : tolerance<b-a) :
    closeCandidate a b tolerance x .right ≤ b-tolerance/2 := by
  have hg : a<b-tolerance/2 := by linarith
  simp only [closeCandidate,hg,and_true]
  split_ifs with h <;> linarith

name: ModAB.Rational.closeCandidate_right_fallback_interior
source:
theorem closeCandidate_right_fallback_interior {a b tolerance : ℝ}
    (ht : 0<tolerance) (hw : tolerance<b-a) :
    closeCandidate a b tolerance b .right ∈ Ioo a b := by
  have hg : a<b-tolerance/2 := by linarith
  have hz : b-b<tolerance/2 := by linarith
  change (if b-b<tolerance/2 ∧ a<b-tolerance/2 then b-tolerance/2 else b) ∈ Ioo a b
  rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hz,hg⟩]
  exact ⟨hg,by linarith⟩

/-- With an outside history node and opposite endpoint ordinates, the normalized
numerator and denominator cannot vanish together in exact arithmetic. This says
nothing about NaN caused by missing history or floating-point overflow. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.numerator_ne_zero_of_denominator_zero
source:
theorem numerator_ne_zero_of_denominator_zero {w u q qp : ℝ}
    (hw : 0<w) (hu : u<0 ∨ w<u) (hq : q<0)
    (hD : normalizedDenominator w u q qp=0) :
    normalizedNumerator w u q qp≠0 := by
  have hwn : w≠0 := ne_of_gt hw
  have hun : u≠0 := by rcases hu with hu|hu <;> linarith
  have hqn : q≠0 := ne_of_lt hq
  intro hn
  unfold normalizedNumerator at hn
  have hqp : qp-1=0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hn).resolve_left
    (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hwn hun) hqn)
  have he : qp=1 := by linarith
  have hwu : w-u≠0 := by rcases hu with hu|hu <;> linarith
  have hc : 1-q≠0 := by linarith
  have hid : normalizedDenominator w u q qp=(w-u)*(1-q) := by
    rw [he]
    unfold normalizedDenominator
    ring
  rw [hid] at hD
  exact (mul_ne_zero hwu hc) hD

/-- Independent coefficient construction: the normalized proposal satisfies
all three cross-multiplied interpolation equations. Genuine function-value
interpolation additionally requires nonzero model denominators at the nodes. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.normalized_interpolation_equations
source:
theorem normalized_interpolation_equations {w u q qp : ℝ}
    (hw : w≠0) (hq : q≠0) (hD : normalizedDenominator w u q qp≠0) :
    let t := normalizedOffset w u q qp
    let p := 1+t*(1-q)/(q*w)
    let Q := -t/q
    (-t=q*Q ∧ w-t=p*w+Q ∧ u-t=qp*(p*u+Q)) := by
  dsimp [normalizedOffset,normalizedNumerator,normalizedDenominator]
  unfold normalizedDenominator at hD
  constructor
  · field_simp [hw,hq,hD]
  constructor
  · field_simp [hw,hq,hD]
    ring
  · field_simp [hw,hq,hD]
    ring

/-- A history record deliberately keeps discarded TRUE residuals. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.HistoryState
source:
structure HistoryState where
  left : ℝ
  right : ℝ
  ordinates : ModAB.Convergence.OrdinateState
  dropped : Option (ℝ×ℝ)

/-- Genuine endpoint replacement: this helper records the removed endpoint.
For source executions that reuse the same coordinate, use recordSourceHistory. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.recordHistory
source:
def recordHistory (s : HistoryState) (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide)
    (x y : ℝ) : HistoryState :=
  match moved with
  | .left => ⟨x,s.right,ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s.ordinates moved y,
      some (s.left,s.ordinates.leftTrue)⟩
  | .right => ⟨s.left,x,ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s.ordinates moved y,
      some (s.right,s.ordinates.rightTrue)⟩

name: ModAB.Rational.recordHistory_true_values
source:
theorem recordHistory_true_values {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : HistoryState)
    (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide) (x : ℝ)
    (hl : s.ordinates.leftTrue=f s.left) (hr : s.ordinates.rightTrue=f s.right) :
    (recordHistory s moved x (f x)).ordinates.leftTrue =
      f (recordHistory s moved x (f x)).left ∧
    (recordHistory s moved x (f x)).ordinates.rightTrue =
      f (recordHistory s moved x (f x)).right := by
  cases moved <;> simp [recordHistory,ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate,hl,hr]

name: ModAB.Rational.recordHistory_dropped_true
source:
theorem recordHistory_dropped_true {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : HistoryState)
    (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide) (x : ℝ)
    (hl : s.ordinates.leftTrue=f s.left) (hr : s.ordinates.rightTrue=f s.right) :
    ∃xp,(recordHistory s moved x (f x)).dropped=some (xp,f xp) := by
  cases moved with
  | left => exact ⟨s.left,by simp [recordHistory,hl]⟩
  | right => exact ⟨s.right,by simp [recordHistory,hr]⟩

/-- Truth of an optional history record: an absent history is allowed. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.TrueHistory
source:
def TrueHistory (f : ℝ→ℝ) (history : Option (ℝ×ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀xp yp,history=some (xp,yp) → yp=f xp

/-- Source-style history guard. Reusing an endpoint preserves the previous
history, but it does not skip the AB ordinate update. In the source a repeated
same-side reuse can still apply an AB correction before this guard. This local
helper uses the old AB-side update and does not encode the source's independent
lastMoved/sideMoved plateau/reset controller. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.recordSourceHistory
source:
def recordSourceHistory (s : HistoryState) (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide)
    (x y : ℝ) : HistoryState :=
  match moved with
  | .left => ⟨x,s.right,ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s.ordinates moved y,
      if x=s.left then s.dropped else some (s.left,s.ordinates.leftTrue)⟩
  | .right => ⟨s.left,x,ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s.ordinates moved y,
      if x=s.right then s.dropped else some (s.right,s.ordinates.rightTrue)⟩

name: ModAB.Rational.recordSourceHistory_true_values
source:
theorem recordSourceHistory_true_values {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : HistoryState)
    (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide) (x : ℝ)
    (hl : s.ordinates.leftTrue=f s.left) (hr : s.ordinates.rightTrue=f s.right) :
    (recordSourceHistory s moved x (f x)).ordinates.leftTrue =
      f (recordSourceHistory s moved x (f x)).left ∧
    (recordSourceHistory s moved x (f x)).ordinates.rightTrue =
      f (recordSourceHistory s moved x (f x)).right := by
  cases moved <;> simp [recordSourceHistory,ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate,hl,hr]

name: ModAB.Rational.recordSourceHistory_history_true
source:
theorem recordSourceHistory_history_true {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : HistoryState)
    (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide) (x : ℝ)
    (hl : s.ordinates.leftTrue=f s.left) (hr : s.ordinates.rightTrue=f s.right)
    (hd : TrueHistory f s.dropped) :
    TrueHistory f (recordSourceHistory s moved x (f x)).dropped := by
  intro xp yp hh
  cases moved with
  | left =>
      by_cases hx : x=s.left
      · exact hd xp yp (by simpa [recordSourceHistory,hx] using hh)
      · have he : s.left=xp ∧ s.ordinates.leftTrue=yp := by
          simpa [recordSourceHistory,hx] using hh
        calc yp = s.ordinates.leftTrue := he.2.symm
             _ = f s.left := hl
             _ = f xp := congrArg f he.1
  | right =>
      by_cases hx : x=s.right
      · exact hd xp yp (by simpa [recordSourceHistory,hx] using hh)
      · have he : s.right=xp ∧ s.ordinates.rightTrue=yp := by
          simpa [recordSourceHistory,hx] using hh
        calc yp = s.ordinates.rightTrue := he.2.symm
             _ = f s.right := hr
             _ = f xp := congrArg f he.1

name: ModAB.Rational.recordSourceHistory_reuse_left
source:
theorem recordSourceHistory_reuse_left (s : HistoryState) (y : ℝ) :
    (recordSourceHistory s .left s.left y).dropped=s.dropped := by
  simp [recordSourceHistory]

name: ModAB.Rational.recordSourceHistory_reuse_right
source:
theorem recordSourceHistory_reuse_right (s : HistoryState) (y : ℝ) :
    (recordSourceHistory s .right s.right y).dropped=s.dropped := by
  simp [recordSourceHistory]

name: ModAB.Rational.recordSourceHistory_left_eq_recordHistory
source:
theorem recordSourceHistory_left_eq_recordHistory {s : HistoryState} {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : x≠s.left) :
    recordSourceHistory s .left x y=recordHistory s .left x y := by
  simp [recordSourceHistory,recordHistory,hx]

name: ModAB.Rational.recordSourceHistory_right_eq_recordHistory
source:
theorem recordSourceHistory_right_eq_recordHistory {s : HistoryState} {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : x≠s.right) :
    recordSourceHistory s .right x y=recordHistory s .right x y := by
  simp [recordSourceHistory,recordHistory,hx]

/-- The endpoint recorded as most recently evaluated has its true ordinate. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.Fresh
source:
def Fresh (s : ModAB.Convergence.OrdinateState) : Prop :=
  match s.previous with
  | some .left => s.leftWork=s.leftTrue
  | some .right => s.rightWork=s.rightTrue
  | none => s.leftWork=s.leftTrue ∧ s.rightWork=s.rightTrue

name: ModAB.Rational.recordUpdate_fresh
source:
theorem recordUpdate_fresh (s : ModAB.Convergence.OrdinateState)
    (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide) (y : ℝ) :
    Fresh (ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s moved y) := by
  cases moved <;> simp [Fresh,ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate]

name: ModAB.Rational.recordUpdate_at_most_one_modified
source:
theorem recordUpdate_at_most_one_modified (s : ModAB.Convergence.OrdinateState)
    (moved : ModAB.Convergence.EndpointSide) (y : ℝ) :
    (ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s moved y).leftWork=
      (ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s moved y).leftTrue ∨
    (ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s moved y).rightWork=
      (ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate s moved y).rightTrue := by
  cases moved <;> simp [ModAB.Convergence.recordUpdate]

/-- When a correction is applied on the same side, the old implementation's
working denominator equals the true replaced residual by the freshness invariant. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.correction_true_denominator
source:
theorem correction_true_denominator (s : ModAB.Convergence.OrdinateState)
    (h : Fresh s) (y : ℝ) :
    (s.previous=some .left → ModAB.Convergence.abFactor y s.leftWork=
      ModAB.Convergence.abFactor y s.leftTrue) ∧
    (s.previous=some .right → ModAB.Convergence.abFactor y s.rightWork=
      ModAB.Convergence.abFactor y s.rightTrue) := by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have he : s.leftWork=s.leftTrue := by simpa [Fresh,hp] using h
    rw [he]
  · intro hp
    have he : s.rightWork=s.rightTrue := by simpa [Fresh,hp] using h
    rw [he]

/-- Same-sign replacement residuals make the AB multiplier a strict contraction;
together with the old positivity theorem this yields a factor in (0,1). -/

name: ModAB.Rational.abFactor_lt_one
source:
theorem abFactor_lt_one {new old : ℝ} (h : 0<new*old) :
    ModAB.Convergence.abFactor new old<1 := by
  have hr : 0<new/old := by
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp h with h|h
    · exact div_pos h.1 h.2
    · exact div_pos_of_neg_of_neg h.1 h.2
  unfold ModAB.Convergence.abFactor
  split_ifs <;> linarith

name: ModAB.Rational.abFactor_mem_Ioo
source:
theorem abFactor_mem_Ioo {new old : ℝ} (h : 0<new*old) :
    ModAB.Convergence.abFactor new old ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 :=
  ⟨ModAB.Convergence.abFactor_positive new old,abFactor_lt_one h⟩

/-- Mixed residuals do not inherit exactness even for f(x)=x: the left ordinate
is multiplied by 1/2, the right ordinate and the dropped value remain true.
The computed point is not the root 0. This is a data-level example, not a claim
that a full run must encounter this state. -/

name: ModAB.Rational.scaled_linear_candidate_example
source:
theorem scaled_linear_candidate_example :
    candidate (-1) 1 (-(1/2:ℝ)) 1 2 2 true=-(1/4:ℝ) := by
  norm_num [candidate,denominator,rawPoint,normalizedOffset,
    normalizedNumerator,normalizedDenominator,limited,radius,secant]

end

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.updated_invariants_closed
source:
theorem updated_invariants_closed {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b x a' b' : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) (hs : f a * f b < 0)
    (hz : f x ≠ 0) (hu : Updated f a b x a' b') :
    a' < b' ∧ f a' * f b' < 0 ∧ Icc a' b' ⊆ Icc a b := by
  unfold Updated at hu
  have hi := interval_update hx
  by_cases hax : f a * f x < 0
  · have hlt : a < x := by
      by_contra hn
      have he : x = a := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) hx.1
      rw [he] at hax
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f a)]
    rw [if_pos hax, Prod.mk.injEq] at hu
    rcases hu with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hlt, hax, hi.1⟩
  · have hxb : f x * f b < 0 := by
      rcases sign_update hs hz with h | h
      · exact False.elim (hax h.1)
      · exact h.1
    have hlt : x < b := by
      by_contra hn
      have he : x = b := le_antisymm hx.2 (le_of_not_gt hn)
      rw [he] at hxb
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f b)]
    rw [if_neg hax, Prod.mk.injEq] at hu
    rcases hu with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hlt, hxb, hi.2.1⟩

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.ClosedExactRun
source:
structure ClosedExactRun (B : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) where
  a : ℕ → ℝ
  b : ℕ → ℝ
  point : ℕ → ℝ
  mode : ℕ → Mode
  initial_order : a 0 < b 0
  initial_sign : f (a 0) * f (b 0) < 0
  continuous : ContinuousOn f (Icc (a 0) (b 0))
  initial_mode : mode 0 = .bisection
  candidate_mem : ∀ n, point n ∈ Icc (a n) (b n)
  nonzero : ∀ n, f (point n) ≠ 0
  update : ∀ n, Updated f (a n) (b n) (point n) (a (n+1)) (b (n+1))
  width_step : ∀ n, Step B M (b n-a n) (mode n)
    (b (n+1)-a (n+1)) (mode (n+1))

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.closed_invariants
source:
theorem closed_invariants {B : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (r : ClosedExactRun B M f) :
    ∀ n, r.a n < r.b n ∧ f (r.a n) * f (r.b n) < 0 ∧
      Icc (r.a (n+1)) (r.b (n+1)) ⊆ Icc (r.a n) (r.b n) := by
  have hs : ∀ n, r.a n < r.b n ∧ f (r.a n) * f (r.b n) < 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨r.initial_order, r.initial_sign⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      have h := updated_invariants_closed ih.1 (r.candidate_mem n) ih.2
        (r.nonzero n) (r.update n)
      exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
  intro n
  exact ⟨(hs n).1, (hs n).2,
    (updated_invariants_closed (hs n).1 (r.candidate_mem n) (hs n).2
      (r.nonzero n) (r.update n)).2.2⟩

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.ClosedExactRun.widthRun
source:
def ClosedExactRun.widthRun {B : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (r : ClosedExactRun B M f) : Run B M where
  width n := r.b n-r.a n
  mode := r.mode
  nonneg_initial := by linarith [r.initial_order]
  initial := r.initial_mode
  next := r.width_step

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.closed_zeros
source:
theorem closed_zeros {B : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (r : ClosedExactRun B M f) :
    ∀ n, ∃ z ∈ Icc (r.a n) (r.b n), f z = 0 := by
  have hi := closed_invariants r
  have hm : Antitone (fun n => Icc (r.a n) (r.b n)) :=
    antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n => (hi n).2.2)
  intro n
  exact bracket_contains_zero (hi n).1.le
    (r.continuous.mono (hm (Nat.zero_le n))) (hi n).2.1

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.capped_global_convergence
source:
theorem capped_global_convergence {B : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hB : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ B) (r : ClosedExactRun B M f) :
    Tendsto (fun n => r.b n-r.a n) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    ∃ x, (⋂ n, Icc (r.a n) (r.b n)) = {x} ∧ f x = 0 := by
  have hw := width_tendsto_zero hB r.widthRun
  exact ⟨hw, nested_intervals_root (fun n => (closed_invariants r n).2.2)
    (closed_zeros r) r.continuous hw⟩

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.capped_global_width
source:
theorem capped_global_width {B : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hB : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ B) (r : ClosedExactRun B M f) (n : ℕ) :
    r.b n-r.a n ≤ (r.b 0-r.a 0) /
      (2 : ℝ)^(n/(dyadicExponent (envelopeConstant B M)+2)) :=
  global_width_bound_log hB r.widthRun.nonneg_initial (history_of_run r.widthRun n)

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.capped_width_seven
source:
theorem capped_width_seven {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (r : ClosedExactRun 2 3 f) (n : ℕ) :
    r.b n-r.a n ≤ (r.b 0-r.a 0) / (2 : ℝ)^(n/7) := by
  exact C32_global_width r.widthRun.nonneg_initial (history_of_run r.widthRun n)

name: ModAB.RationalBridge.capped_finite_tolerance
source:
theorem capped_finite_tolerance {B τ : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hB : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ B) (hτ : 0 < τ) (r : ClosedExactRun B M f) :
    let q := dyadicExponent (envelopeConstant B M)+2
    let K := toleranceExponent (r.b 0-r.a 0) τ
    r.b (q*K)-r.a (q*K) ≤ τ := by
  dsimp
  exact finite_termination hB r.widthRun.nonneg_initial
    (ceil_log_bound (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (C_at_least_one hB)))
    (tolerance_exponent_sufficient r.widthRun.nonneg_initial hτ)
    (history_of_run r.widthRun _)

end

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.eventually_short_steps
source:
theorem eventually_short_steps {x : ℕ → ℝ} {z δ : ℝ}
    (hx : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 z)) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, |x (n + 1) - x n| < δ := by
  have hshift : Tendsto (fun n => x (n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 z) :=
    (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr hx
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun n => |x (n + 1) - x n|) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa using (hshift.sub hx).abs
  exact (tendsto_order.mp hzero).2 δ hδ

/-- A positive closing distance on an entire infinite suffix is incompatible
with point convergence.  A finite number of earlier bisections is immaterial. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.no_convergent_separated_tail
source:
theorem no_convergent_separated_tail {x : ℕ → ℝ} {z δ : ℝ}
    (hx : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 z)) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, δ ≤ |x (n + 1) - x n|) : False := by
  obtain ⟨n, hsmall, hlarge⟩ := ((eventually_short_steps hx hδ).and hsep).exists
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hlarge) hsmall

/-- Conditional width termination for a convergent sequence whose accepted
closing steps enforce a fixed positive spacing whenever the width test has
not yet passed.  Proving the spacing premise is an implementation obligation. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.exists_width_stop_of_converges
source:
theorem exists_width_stop_of_converges {x width : ℕ → ℝ} {z δ τ : ℝ}
    (hx : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 z)) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, τ < width n → δ ≤ |x (n + 1) - x n|) :
    ∃ n, width n ≤ τ := by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply no_convergent_separated_tail hx hδ
  filter_upwards [hclose] with n hn
  exact hn (h n)

name: ModAB.RationalResidual.limit_is_zero
source:
theorem limit_is_zero {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b z : ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hz : z ∈ Icc a b)
    (hx : ∀ n, x n ∈ Icc a b) (hlim : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 z))
    (hres : Tendsto (fun n => |f (x n)|) atTop (𝓝 0)) : f z = 0 := by
  have hfseq : Tendsto (fun n => f (x n)) atTop (𝓝 (f z)) :=
    (hf z hz).tendsto.comp
      (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hlim, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hx⟩)
  have he : |f z| = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hfseq.abs hres
  exact abs_eq_zero.mp he

/-- Residual convergence gives proximity to the zero set, even if the
enclosing intervals have a positive limiting width or the zero is not unique.
The witness is an actual zero in the original interval. -/

name: ModAB.RationalResidual.eventually_near_zero_set
source:
theorem eventually_near_zero_set {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hx : ∀ n, x n ∈ Icc a b)
    (hres : Tendsto (fun n => |f (x n)|) atTop (𝓝 0))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ z ∈ Icc a b, f z = 0 ∧ |x n - z| < ε := by
  by_contra h
  have hbad : ∃ᶠ n in atTop,
      ¬ (∃ z ∈ Icc a b, f z = 0 ∧ |x n - z| < ε) := not_eventually.mp h
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hψbad⟩ := extraction_of_frequently_atTop hbad
  obtain ⟨z, hz, φ, hφ, ht⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.tendsto_subseq (fun n => hx (ψ n))
  have ht' : Tendsto (fun n => x (ψ (φ n))) atTop (𝓝 z) := ht
  have hr' : Tendsto (fun n => |f (x (ψ (φ n)))|) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    hres.comp (hψ.tendsto_atTop.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
  have hz0 : f z = 0 := limit_is_zero hf hz (fun n => hx (ψ (φ n))) ht' hr'
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp ht' ε hε
  have hd : |x (ψ (φ N)) - z| < ε := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hN N (le_refl N)
  exact hψbad (φ N) ⟨z, hz, hz0, hd⟩

/-- With a unique zero in the original interval, residual convergence implies
convergence of the evaluated points themselves. No derivative bound is used. -/

name: ModAB.RationalResidual.tendsto_unique_zero
source:
theorem tendsto_unique_zero {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b r : ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hx : ∀ n, x n ∈ Icc a b)
    (hres : Tendsto (fun n => |f (x n)|) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hunique : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b, f z = 0 → z = r) :
    Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 r) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have he := eventually_near_zero_set hf hx hres hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp he
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0, hd⟩ := hN n hn
  have hzr := hunique z hz hz0
  simpa only [hzr, Real.dist_eq] using hd

end

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.Mode
source:
inductive Mode where
  | bisection
  | interpolation (scale : ℝ) (clock : ℕ)

/-- `m` is the smaller true endpoint residual before the update. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.Step
source:
inductive Step (B η m : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ → Mode → ℝ → ℝ → Mode → Prop
  | bisectStay (w R R') : Step B η m w R .bisection (w/2) R' .bisection
  | bisectStart (w R R') :
      Step B η m w R .bisection (w/2) R' (.interpolation (w/2) 0)
  | width {w w' R R' S t} : 0≤w' → w'≤w →
      w'≤threshold B S (t+1) →
      Step B η m w R (.interpolation S t) w' R' (.interpolation S (t+1))
  | residual {w w' R R' S t} : 0≤w' → w'≤w →
      threshold B S (t+1)<w' → R'<η*m →
      Step B η m w R (.interpolation S t) w' R' (.interpolation S (t+1))
  | stop {w w' R R' S t} : 0≤w' → w'≤w →
      Step B η m w R (.interpolation S t) w' R' .bisection

/-- The actual uncapped continuation decision.  Neither successful width tests
nor residual exceptions reset the phase clock. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.nextMode
ModAB.RationalUncapped.decision_step
source:
theorem decision_step {B η S m w R w' R' : ℝ} {t : ℕ}
    (h0 : 0≤w') (hmono : w'≤w) :
    Step B η m w R (.interpolation S t) w' R' (nextMode B η S m w' R' t) := by
  unfold nextMode
  split_ifs with hw hr
  · exact .width h0 hmono hw
  · exact .residual h0 hmono (lt_of_not_ge hw) hr
  · exact .stop h0 hmono

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.forty_two_test
source:
theorem forty_two_test (R m : ℝ) : R<(1/42:ℝ)*m ↔ 42*R<m := by
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

/-- Residual `R n` belongs to the point evaluated most recently.  That point is
an endpoint, so the smaller endpoint residual is at most `R n`. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.Run
source:
structure Run (B η : ℝ) where
  width : ℕ→ℝ
  residual : ℕ→ℝ
  minimum : ℕ→ℝ
  mode : ℕ→Mode
  nonneg_initial : 0≤width 0
  nonneg_residual : ∀n,0≤residual n
  minimum_le : ∀n,minimum n≤residual n
  next : ∀n,Step B η (minimum n) (width n) (residual n) (mode n)
    (width (n+1)) (residual (n+1)) (mode (n+1))

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.step_nonnegative
source:
theorem step_nonnegative {B η m w R w' R' : ℝ} {s s' : Mode}
    (hs : Step B η m w R s w' R' s') (hw : 0≤w) : 0≤w' := by
  cases hs with
  | bisectStay => positivity
  | bisectStart => positivity
  | width h _ _ => exact h
  | residual h _ _ _ => exact h
  | stop h _ => exact h

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.run_nonnegative
source:
theorem run_nonnegative {B η : ℝ} (r : Run B η) (n : ℕ) : 0≤r.width n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact r.nonneg_initial
  | succ n ih => exact step_nonnegative (r.next n) ih

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.step_nonincrease
source:
theorem step_nonincrease {B η m w R w' R' : ℝ} {s s' : Mode}
    (hs : Step B η m w R s w' R' s') (hw : 0≤w) : w'≤w := by
  cases hs with
  | bisectStay => linarith
  | bisectStart => linarith
  | width _ h _ => exact h
  | residual _ h _ _ => exact h
  | stop _ h => exact h

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.width_antitone
source:
theorem width_antitone {B η : ℝ} (r : Run B η) : Antitone r.width :=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n=>step_nonincrease (r.next n) (run_nonnegative r n))

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.isBisection
source:
def isBisection : Mode→Bool
  | .bisection=>true
  | .interpolation _ _=>false

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.bisectionCount
source:
def bisectionCount (m : ℕ→Mode) : ℕ→ℕ
  | 0=>0
  | n+1=>bisectionCount m n + if isBisection (m n) then 1 else 0

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.count_monotone
source:
theorem count_monotone (m : ℕ→Mode) : Monotone (bisectionCount m) := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro n
  simp only [bisectionCount]
  omega

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.step_count_bound
source:
theorem step_count_bound {B η m W0 w R w' R' : ℝ} {k : ℕ} {s s' : Mode}
    (hs : Step B η m w R s w' R' s') (hw : w≤W0/(2:ℝ)^k) :
    w'≤W0/(2:ℝ)^(k+if isBisection s then 1 else 0) := by
  cases hs with
  | bisectStay =>
      simp only [isBisection,ite_true,pow_succ]
      exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hw (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)).trans_eq (by ring)
  | bisectStart =>
      simp only [isBisection,ite_true,pow_succ]
      exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hw (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)).trans_eq (by ring)
  | width _ hm _ => simpa [isBisection] using hm.trans hw
  | residual _ hm _ _ => simpa [isBisection] using hm.trans hw
  | stop _ hm => simpa [isBisection] using hm.trans hw

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.bisection_count_bound
source:
theorem bisection_count_bound {B η : ℝ} (r : Run B η) (n : ℕ) :
    r.width n≤r.width 0/(2:ℝ)^(bisectionCount r.mode n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [bisectionCount]
  | succ n ih => exact step_count_bound (r.next n) ih

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.count_unbounded
source:
theorem count_unbounded {m : ℕ→Mode}
    (h : ∀N,∃n,N≤n ∧ isBisection (m n)=true) : ∀k,∃n,k≤bisectionCount m n := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨0,by simp [bisectionCount]⟩
  | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨n,hn⟩:=ih
      obtain ⟨j,hnj,hj⟩:=h n
      refine ⟨j+1,?_⟩
      have hm:=count_monotone m hnj
      simp only [bisectionCount,hj,ite_true]
      omega

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.infinite_bisections
source:
theorem infinite_bisections {B η : ℝ} (r : Run B η)
    (h : ∀N,∃n,N≤n ∧ isBisection (r.mode n)=true) :
    Tendsto r.width atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hc : Tendsto (bisectionCount r.mode) atTop atTop := by
    apply tendsto_atTop_atTop.mpr
    intro k
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩:=count_unbounded h k
    exact ⟨n,fun j hj=>hn.trans (count_monotone r.mode hj)⟩
  exact squeeze_zero (run_nonnegative r) (bisection_count_bound r)
    ((dyadic_tendsto _).comp hc)

/-- There is no reset of a continuing phase's scale or clock. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.continuing_step
source:
theorem continuing_step {B η m w R w' R' S : ℝ} {t : ℕ} {s' : Mode}
    (hs : Step B η m w R (.interpolation S t) w' R' s')
    (hno : isBisection s'=false) :
    s'=.interpolation S (t+1) ∧
      (w'≤threshold B S (t+1) ∨ R'<η*m) := by
  cases hs with
  | width _ _ ht => exact ⟨rfl,Or.inl ht⟩
  | residual _ _ _ hr => exact ⟨rfl,Or.inr hr⟩
  | stop => simp [isBisection] at hno

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.continuing_suffix
source:
theorem continuing_suffix {B η S : ℝ} {N t : ℕ} (r : Run B η)
    (hm : r.mode N=.interpolation S t)
    (hno : ∀n,N≤n→isBisection (r.mode n)=false) :
    ∀k,r.mode (N+k)=.interpolation S (t+k) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ k ih =>
      have hs:=r.next (N+k)
      rw [ih] at hs
      have he:=(continuing_step hs (hno (N+k+1) (by omega))).1
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using he

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.small_widths_tendsto
source:
theorem small_widths_tendsto {B η : ℝ} (r : Run B η)
    (h : ∀ε:ℝ,0<ε→∃n,r.width n<ε) : Tendsto r.width atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩:=h ε hε
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn=>?_⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (run_nonnegative r n)]
  exact (width_antitone r hn).trans_lt hN

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.geometric_residual
source:
theorem geometric_residual {R : ℕ→ℝ} {η : ℝ} (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1)
    (hR : ∀n,0≤R n) (hstep : ∀n,R (n+1)≤η*R n) :
    Tendsto R atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hb : ∀n,R n≤η^n*R 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      calc R (n+1)≤η*R n:=hstep n
           _≤η*(η^n*R 0):=mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hη0
           _=η^(n+1)*R 0:=by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  exact squeeze_zero hR hb
    (by simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hη0 hη1).mul_const (R 0))

/-- The uncapped policy guarantees width convergence or residual convergence.
This is derived from the transition system, not postulated as a run property. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.width_or_residual
source:
theorem width_or_residual {B η : ℝ} (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1) (r : Run B η) :
    Tendsto r.width atTop (𝓝 0) ∨ Tendsto r.residual atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  by_cases hsmall : ∀ε:ℝ,0<ε→∃n,r.width n<ε
  · exact Or.inl (small_widths_tendsto r hsmall)
  push Not at hsmall
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hfloor⟩:=hsmall
  by_cases hb : ∀N,∃n,N≤n ∧ isBisection (r.mode n)=true
  · exact Or.inl (infinite_bisections r hb)
  push Not at hb
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩:=hb
  have hno : ∀n,N≤n→isBisection (r.mode n)=false := by
    intro n hn
    exact Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (hN n hn)
  obtain ⟨S,t,hm⟩ : ∃S t,r.mode N=.interpolation S t := by
    cases he : r.mode N with
    | bisection => simpa [he,isBisection] using hno N (le_refl N)
    | interpolation S t => exact ⟨S,t,rfl⟩
  have hmode:=continuing_suffix r hm hno
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun k:ℕ=>threshold B S (t+k+1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    convert dyadic_tendsto (2*B*S/(2:ℝ)^(t+1)) using 1
    funext k
    simp only [threshold,show t+k+1=(t+1)+k by omega,pow_add,div_mul_eq_div_div]
  obtain ⟨K,hK⟩:=Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim ε hε
  have hcontract : ∀k,r.residual (N+K+k+1)≤η*r.residual (N+K+k) := by
    intro k
    have hs:=r.next (N+(K+k))
    rw [hmode (K+k)] at hs
    have hor:=(continuing_step hs (hno (N+(K+k)+1) (by omega))).2
    have ht : threshold B S (t+(K+k)+1)<ε := by
      have hk:=hK (K+k) (by omega)
      rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero] at hk
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans_lt hk
    rcases hor with hw|hr
    · have hf:=hfloor (N+(K+k)+1)
      linarith
    · have hh:=hr.le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (r.minimum_le (N+(K+k))) hη0)
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hh
  have hr : Tendsto (fun k=>r.residual (N+K+k)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    geometric_residual hη0 hη1 (fun k=>r.nonneg_residual _) (by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hcontract)
  exact Or.inr ((tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat (N+K)).mp (by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hr))

/-- Any positive width-or-residual stopping tolerances are attained.  Continuity
is unnecessary for this scheduling statement. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.finite_combined_tolerance
source:
theorem finite_combined_tolerance {B η τw τf : ℝ} (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1)
    (hτw : 0<τw) (hτf : 0<τf) (r : Run B η) :
    ∃n,r.width n<τw ∨ r.residual n<τf := by
  rcases width_or_residual hη0 hη1 r with hw|hr
  · obtain ⟨N,hN⟩:=Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hw τw hτw
    refine ⟨N,Or.inl ?_⟩
    have h:=hN N (le_refl N)
    simpa [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_nonneg (run_nonnegative r N)] using h
  · obtain ⟨N,hN⟩:=Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hr τf hτf
    refine ⟨N,Or.inr ?_⟩
    have h:=hN N (le_refl N)
    simpa [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_nonneg (r.nonneg_residual N)] using h

/-- A nonterminating exact run.  `point 0` is an initial endpoint and `point
(n+1)` is the new trial inserted by update `n`. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.ExactRun
source:
structure ExactRun (B η : ℝ) (f : ℝ→ℝ) where
  a : ℕ→ℝ
  b : ℕ→ℝ
  point : ℕ→ℝ
  mode : ℕ→Mode
  initial_order : a 0<b 0
  initial_sign : f (a 0)*f (b 0)<0
  initial_point : point 0=a 0 ∨ point 0=b 0
  continuous : ContinuousOn f (Icc (a 0) (b 0))
  candidate_mem : ∀n,point (n+1)∈Icc (a n) (b n)
  nonzero : ∀n,f (point (n+1))≠0
  update : ∀n,Updated f (a n) (b n) (point (n+1)) (a (n+1)) (b (n+1))
  policy : ∀n,Step B η (min |f (a n)| |f (b n)|)
    (b n-a n) |f (point n)| (mode n)
    (b (n+1)-a (n+1)) |f (point (n+1))| (mode (n+1))

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.exact_invariants
source:
theorem exact_invariants {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B η f) :
    ∀n,r.a n<r.b n ∧ f (r.a n)*f (r.b n)<0 ∧
      Icc (r.a (n+1)) (r.b (n+1))⊆Icc (r.a n) (r.b n) := by
  have hs : ∀n,r.a n<r.b n ∧ f (r.a n)*f (r.b n)<0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨r.initial_order,r.initial_sign⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      exact (ModAB.RationalBridge.updated_invariants_closed ih.1 (r.candidate_mem n)
        ih.2 (r.nonzero n) (r.update n)).imp_right And.left
  intro n
  exact ⟨(hs n).1,(hs n).2,
    (ModAB.RationalBridge.updated_invariants_closed (hs n).1 (r.candidate_mem n)
      (hs n).2 (r.nonzero n) (r.update n)).2.2⟩

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.point_endpoint
source:
theorem point_endpoint {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B η f) (n : ℕ) :
    r.point n=r.a n ∨ r.point n=r.b n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact r.initial_point
  | succ n =>
    have hu:=r.update n
    unfold Updated at hu
    split_ifs at hu with hs
    · exact Or.inr (congrArg Prod.snd hu).symm
    · exact Or.inl (congrArg Prod.fst hu).symm

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.point_mem
source:
theorem point_mem {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B η f) (n : ℕ) :
    r.point n∈Icc (r.a n) (r.b n) := by
  rcases point_endpoint r n with h|h
  · rw [h]; exact ⟨le_refl _,(exact_invariants r n).1.le⟩
  · rw [h]; exact ⟨(exact_invariants r n).1.le,le_refl _⟩

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.point_mem_initial
source:
theorem point_mem_initial {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B η f) (n : ℕ) :
    r.point n∈Icc (r.a 0) (r.b 0) := by
  have hm : Antitone (fun n=>Icc (r.a n) (r.b n)) :=
    antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n=>(exact_invariants r n).2.2)
  exact hm (Nat.zero_le n) (point_mem r n)

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.ExactRun.policyRun
source:
def ExactRun.policyRun {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B η f) : Run B η where
  width n:=r.b n-r.a n
  residual n:=|f (r.point n)|
  minimum n:=min |f (r.a n)| |f (r.b n)|
  mode:=r.mode
  nonneg_initial:=by linarith [r.initial_order]
  nonneg_residual n:=abs_nonneg _
  minimum_le n:=by
    rcases point_endpoint r n with h|h
    · rw [h]; exact min_le_left _ _
    · rw [h]; exact min_le_right _ _
  next:=r.policy

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.exact_zeros
source:
theorem exact_zeros {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B η f) :
    ∀n,∃z∈Icc (r.a n) (r.b n),f z=0 := by
  have hi:=exact_invariants r
  have hm : Antitone (fun n=>Icc (r.a n) (r.b n)):=
    antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n=>(hi n).2.2)
  intro n
  exact bracket_contains_zero (hi n).1.le
    (r.continuous.mono (hm (Nat.zero_le n))) (hi n).2.1

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.residual_of_width
source:
theorem residual_of_width {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B η f)
    (hw : Tendsto (fun n=>r.b n-r.a n) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n=>|f (r.point n)|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hfz⟩:=nested_intervals_root
    (fun n=>(exact_invariants r n).2.2) (exact_zeros r) r.continuous hw
  have hzall : ∀n,z∈Icc (r.a n) (r.b n) := by
    apply mem_iInter.mp
    rw [hz]
    exact mem_singleton _
  have hp:=chosen_points_tendsto hzall (point_mem r) hw
  have hf : Tendsto (fun n=>f (r.point n)) atTop (𝓝 (f z)) :=
    (r.continuous z (hzall 0)).tendsto.comp
      (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hp,Filter.Eventually.of_forall (point_mem_initial r)⟩)
  simpa [hfz] using hf.abs

/-- Full residual convergence for continuous sign-bracketed functions and the
actual uncapped width-or-residual continuation schedule. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.global_residual_convergence
source:
theorem global_residual_convergence {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ}
    (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1) (r : ExactRun B η f) :
    Tendsto (fun n=>|f (r.point n)|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  rcases width_or_residual hη0 hη1 r.policyRun with hw|hr
  · exact residual_of_width r hw
  · exact hr

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.finite_residual_tolerance
source:
theorem finite_residual_tolerance {B η τ : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ}
    (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1) (hτ : 0<τ) (r : ExactRun B η f) :
    ∃N,∀n,N≤n→|f (r.point n)|<τ := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩:=Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (global_residual_convergence hη0 hη1 r) τ hτ
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn=>?_⟩
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN n hn

/-- The concrete factor used by the uncapped implementation. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.eta42_global_residual
source:
theorem eta42_global_residual {B : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (r : ExactRun B (1/42) f) :
    Tendsto (fun n=>|f (r.point n)|) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  global_residual_convergence (by norm_num) (by norm_num) r

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.eventually_near_zero_set
source:
theorem eventually_near_zero_set {B η ε : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ}
    (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1) (hε : 0<ε) (r : ExactRun B η f) :
    ∀ᶠn in atTop,∃z∈Icc (r.a 0) (r.b 0),f z=0 ∧ |r.point n-z|<ε :=
  ModAB.RationalResidual.eventually_near_zero_set r.continuous (point_mem_initial r)
    (global_residual_convergence hη0 hη1 r) hε

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.unique_root_convergence
source:
theorem unique_root_convergence {B η z : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ}
    (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1) (r : ExactRun B η f)
    (hunique : ∀x∈Icc (r.a 0) (r.b 0),f x=0→x=z) :
    Tendsto r.point atTop (𝓝 z) :=
  ModAB.RationalResidual.tendsto_unique_zero r.continuous (point_mem_initial r)
    (global_residual_convergence hη0 hη1 r) hunique

/-- Conditional width termination from a positive closing distance.  The
spacing premise refers to accepted/evaluated points; it must be checked for
the implementation's closing-step and rounding guards. -/

name: ModAB.RationalUncapped.width_stop_with_closing
source:
theorem width_stop_with_closing {B η z δ τ : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ}
    (hη0 : 0≤η) (hη1 : η<1) (r : ExactRun B η f)
    (hunique : ∀x∈Icc (r.a 0) (r.b 0),f x=0→x=z) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠn in atTop,τ<r.b n-r.a n→δ≤|r.point (n+1)-r.point n|) :
    ∃n,r.b n-r.a n≤τ :=
  exists_width_stop_of_converges (unique_root_convergence hη0 hη1 r hunique) hδ hclose

end

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.RecentEndpoint
source:
def RecentEndpoint (a b latest : ℝ) : EndpointSide→Prop
  | .left => latest=a
  | .right => latest=b

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.stepPoint
source:
def stepPoint (a b tolerance pre : ℝ) (recent : EndpointSide) :
    ModAB.RationalUncapped.Mode→ℝ
  | .bisection => (a+b)/2
  | .interpolation _ _ => closeCandidate a b tolerance pre recent

/-- The source proposal relation, including its endpoint fallback, supplies
closed membership after the guarded closing operation. -/

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.source_closed_update
source:
theorem source_closed_update {f : ℝ→ℝ} {a b ya yb pre tolerance x a' b' : ℝ}
    (recent : EndpointSide) (hab : a<b) (hs : f a*f b<0)
    (hya : SameSign ya (f a)) (hyb : SameSign yb (f b))
    (hp : SourceProposal a b ya yb pre) (ht : 0<tolerance)
    (hx : x=closeCandidate a b tolerance pre recent)
    (hz : f x≠0) (hu : Updated f a b x a' b') :
    a'<b' ∧ f a'*f b'<0 ∧ Icc a' b'⊆Icc a b := by
  have hpre:=sourceProposal_mem_closed hab (working_opposite hya hyb hs) hp
  have hc : x∈Icc a b := by
    rw [hx]
    exact closeCandidate_mem_closed recent ht hpre
  exact ModAB.RationalBridge.updated_invariants_closed hab hc hs hz hu

/-- Operational data.  The phase clock advances through `nextMode`; neither
bracket membership nor width contraction is postulated.  The working-sign
premises are supplied by positive AB corrections in the ordinate-state layer. -/

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.SourceRun
source:
structure SourceRun (B η : ℝ) (f : ℝ→ℝ) where
  a : ℕ→ℝ
  b : ℕ→ℝ
  point : ℕ→ℝ
  mode : ℕ→ModAB.RationalUncapped.Mode
  ya : ℕ→ℝ
  yb : ℕ→ℝ
  preproposal : ℕ→ℝ
  tolerance : ℕ→ℝ
  recent : ℕ→EndpointSide
  initial_order : a 0<b 0
  initial_sign : f (a 0)*f (b 0)<0
  initial_point : point 0=a 0 ∨ point 0=b 0
  initial_mode : mode 0=.bisection
  continuous : ContinuousOn f (Icc (a 0) (b 0))
  working_left : ∀n,SameSign (ya n) (f (a n))
  working_right : ∀n,SameSign (yb n) (f (b n))
  proposal : ∀n,SourceProposal (a n) (b n) (ya n) (yb n) (preproposal n)
  tolerance_pos : ∀n,0<tolerance n
  recent_correct : ∀n S t,mode n=.interpolation S t→
    RecentEndpoint (a n) (b n) (point n) (recent n)
  point_rule : ∀n,point (n+1)=stepPoint (a n) (b n) (tolerance n)
    (preproposal n) (recent n) (mode n)
  nonzero : ∀n,f (point (n+1))≠0
  update : ∀n,Updated f (a n) (b n) (point (n+1)) (a (n+1)) (b (n+1))
  bisect_mode : ∀n,mode n=.bisection→
    mode (n+1)=.bisection ∨ mode (n+1)=.interpolation ((b n-a n)/2) 0
  continue_mode : ∀n S t,mode n=.interpolation S t→
    mode (n+1)=ModAB.RationalUncapped.nextMode B η S
      (min |f (a n)| |f (b n)|) (b (n+1)-a (n+1)) |f (point (n+1))| t

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.proposal_mem_of_invariants
source:
theorem proposal_mem_of_invariants {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ}
    (s : SourceRun B η f) (n : ℕ) (hab : s.a n<s.b n)
    (hs : f (s.a n)*f (s.b n)<0) : s.point (n+1)∈Icc (s.a n) (s.b n) := by
  rw [s.point_rule n]
  cases hm : s.mode n with
  | bisection =>
    simp only [stepPoint]
    constructor <;> linarith
  | interpolation S t =>
    simp only [stepPoint]
    exact closeCandidate_mem_closed (s.recent n) (s.tolerance_pos n)
      (sourceProposal_mem_closed hab
        (working_opposite (s.working_left n) (s.working_right n) hs) (s.proposal n))

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.source_invariants
source:
theorem source_invariants {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : SourceRun B η f) :
    ∀n,s.a n<s.b n ∧ f (s.a n)*f (s.b n)<0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨s.initial_order,s.initial_sign⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have h:=ModAB.RationalBridge.updated_invariants_closed ih.1
      (proposal_mem_of_invariants s n ih.1 ih.2) ih.2 (s.nonzero n) (s.update n)
    exact ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.source_candidate_mem
source:
theorem source_candidate_mem {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : SourceRun B η f) (n : ℕ) :
    s.point (n+1)∈Icc (s.a n) (s.b n) :=
  proposal_mem_of_invariants s n (source_invariants s n).1 (source_invariants s n).2

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.source_width_step
source:
theorem source_width_step {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : SourceRun B η f) (n : ℕ) :
    0≤s.b (n+1)-s.a (n+1) ∧ s.b (n+1)-s.a (n+1)≤s.b n-s.a n := by
  have hx:=source_candidate_mem s n
  have hu:=s.update n
  unfold Updated at hu
  split_ifs at hu with hs
  · rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at hu
    rw [hu.1,hu.2]
    constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2]
  · rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at hu
    rw [hu.1,hu.2]
    constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2]

name: ModAB.RationalAssembly.source_bisection_width
source:
theorem source_bisection_width {B η : ℝ} {f : ℝ→ℝ} (s : SourceRun B η f)
    (n : ℕ) (hm : s.mode n=.bisection) :
    s.b (n+1)-s.a (n+1)=(s.b n-s.a n)/2 := by
